about.text: Australia’s everyday cream: at least 35 % fat, as all cream there must have, with gelatine or another thickener added so that it whips firmer and holds.

how.text: It is ordinary cream with a thickener stirred in, so it whips firmer and holds its shape. Nothing is soured: the thickening is physical, not a ferment. Thickener amounts are not stated in the sources opened.

links.name: Food Standards Code, Standard 2.5.2 (cream: at least 350 g/kg milkfat)
